name: Dreacot Delivery
author: dreacot

sections.description:
Dreacot Delivery provides a seamless logistics solution tailored to online stores. With our plugin, you can display real-time shipping rates at checkout, offering accurate pricing to customers. Once an order is placed, our riders will pick up the items from your store and deliver them directly to customers. Both store owners and customers can enjoy real-time tracking for transparency and peace of mind.

  • Display accurate real-time shipping rates at checkout.
  • Enable efficient item pickups from your store.
  • Ensure swift deliveries to your customers.
  • Offer real-time delivery tracking for both store owners and customers.
  • Built for reliability, transparency, and enhanced customer satisfaction.

This plugin relies on remote API calls to the Dreacot Delivery API service, which is hosted at https://api.dreacotdelivery.com. The API enables real-time shipping calculations, order scheduling, and tracking.

You would require a partner account to get your API keys to use this plugin, signup at https://partner.dreacotdelivery.com/register

Setup steps;

  1. https://partner.dreacotdelivery.com/login
  2. Enter the provided login details
  3. Go the Ecommerce navigation on the sidebar
  4. Click on integrations and enable WooCommerce
  5. Click on API Keys, and get your api keys
  6. Go the Dreacot app installed on your WooCommerce store
  7. Go to settings and add the api keys
  8. Then you can order something from your store, and you would see the Dreacot Delivery shipping option

For more details, visit Dreacot Delivery.

sections.faq:
How does Dreacot Delivery calculate shipping rates?

Shipping rates are calculated in real-time based on the delivery distance, item weight, and other factors to ensure accuracy.

Can customers track their orders?

Yes, both the store owner and the customer receive a real-time tracking link to monitor the delivery process.

Is Dreacot Delivery available in my city?

We are continuously expanding our service areas. Please check our service coverage page for the latest updates.

Is there a cost to use the API?

Yes, you need an active Dreacot Delivery Partner account to use this plugin. Pricing depends on the services you choose. Visit Dreacot Delivery Partner for more information.

Why does the plugin call an external API?

The plugin depends on the Dreacot Delivery API to provide real-time shipping rates, manage delivery scheduling, and enable tracking for orders. Without these API calls, the plugin cannot function.

Are the API calls secure?

Yes, all API calls are made over HTTPS and adhere to industry-standard security practices.
